[[File:DrinkChit-XWA.png|thumb|Drinking chit used on the ''Dunari's Rest'']]
A '''drinking chit''' was a voucher that were exchangeable for drinks, particularly of the [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] variety. As such, they are common on drinking bars.

The [[Casino/Legends|casino]]/resort [[Space station/Legends|space station]] ''[[Dunari's Rest]]'' utilized drinking chits that showed a drink similar to that of the [[Zairona Ale]], inferring that the bar sold the illegal drink. [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] was supplied one of these chits by his brother [[Emon Azzameen]] as compensation for being kicked out of the bar due to attacking the [[Viraxo Industries]]-aligned starship ''[[Enkidu]]''. Ace later included it among his trophy collection of various items he procured during his missions as a memento to the occasion.
